'''Pashevir Duine''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]] who worked as an [[engineer]] for the [[Sublights Products Corporation]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. In [[13 BBY]], he attempted to [[Smuggler|smuggle]] [[engine]] schematics stolen from the [[Kuat Drive Yards office]] through the [[Coronet City Spaceport|Coronet Spaceport]] on [[Corellia]], hoping customs officials would be distracted by his grav-pallet handtruck filled with [[Corellian wine]]s.<ref name="TOG" />
